title: Welcome to ImGui Lab
summary: What Dear ImGui is, why game engines use it for editors and debug tools, and how this platform compiles your code into a real OpenGL window.

quiz.q: What does Dear ImGui actually output each frame?
options: A list of textured triangles that a renderer backend draws
A bitmap that is blitted with GDI
quiz.explain: ImGui builds vertex/index buffers (ImDrawData). The OpenGL2 backend draws them on top of your scene.

quiz.q: Which two functions must your lesson code define?
quiz.explain: The engine's OGL.c includes Lesson.inl and calls Lesson_Init() once and Lesson_UI() every frame.

quiz.q: You right-drag while the mouse is over an ImGui window. What happens?
options: Nothing in the 3D view - ImGui owns the mouse there
quiz.explain: The engine checks io.WantCaptureMouse and leaves the mouse to the UI when it's over an ImGui window.
